    Class Viewport

    Viewport owns the affine transform that maps data coordinates to screen pixels. It handles zoom animation, pan constraints, and LOD parameters.

    Example

    Runnable example association: crs-switch, project.

    Methods

    applyCameraState

    • applyCameraState(center: [number, number], scale: number): void

      Set the transform so center (data coords) sits at the viewport centre at scale (= |mx|), preserving the existing flipY (my<0) convention, then re-apply pan/zoom constraints. Additive primitive for the Camera; does not touch setExtent/reset state. Callers own the render / onViewChange trigger after this call (the Camera fires the move/zoom lifecycle itself).

      Parameters

      • center: [number, number]

        center accepts tuple number, number for applyCameraState. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to tuple number, number.

      • scale: number

        scale accepts number for applyCameraState. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to number.

      Returns void

      • Defined in src/geo/viewport.ts:114

    getCameraState

    • getCameraState(): { center: [number, number]; scale: number }

      Current camera state in projected/data coordinates. center is the data point at the viewport centre (same space as unproject and getExtent, before any CRS/geographic mapping). scale is |mx|.

      Returns { center: [number, number]; scale: number }
